projects.title: Modular AI ERP Agent System
projects.description: A conversational backend system that lets users manage ERP records directly through Telegram&whatsapp
projects.fullDescription: Architected a modular ERP assistant that connects Telegram interfaces with a PostgreSQL backend via custom Supabase stored functions and triggers. Automated inventory management, sales recording, purchase order processing, and expense tracking through flexible n8n tool nodes
highlights: Built a full ERP automation system managed directly via Telegram interface.
Integrated PostgreSQL functions and database triggers for real-time inventory and sales updates.
Designed dynamic n8n tool nodes to execute structured database queries via natural language commands.
Automated expense tracking, purchase orders, and employee records with sub-second response times.

projects.title: Autonomous Dental Clinic Management System
projects.description: An end-to-end multi-agent AI system designed to automate patient booking, management, and reminders.
projects.fullDescription: Developed an autonomous clinic management ecosystem using n8n and multi-agent AI framework. Integrated Telegram Bot API for real-time patient interactions, Supabase Vector Store for semantic query resolution, and Google Sheets alongside Gmail API for automated appointment scheduling, database tracking, and client notifications.
highlights: Architected an autonomous multi-agent system managing end-to-end dental clinic workflows.
Integrated Telegram Bot API to handle instant patient bookings, inquiries, and automated reminders.
Leveraged Supabase Vector Store for semantic search and accurate medical knowledge retrieval.
